integrity: Analytic arguments with cited infinite-mean renewal theorems and a separately executable finite consistency script; no independent validation or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed two-particle, independent one-dimensional zero-drift diffusion with immediate joint resets at a common upper threshold; no independent priority certification. Renewal-age marginal is an application of Erickson (1970), not a new theorem. Finite numerical checks do not establish asymptotic claims.
title: Logarithmic aging and universal two-particle statistics at a first-passage resetting threshold
